notes: A bounded two-member slice of the independently green 62-assertion native restore-control case. Under HLA_IMMEDIATE, a completed baseline save precedes object registration and discovery. During restore, status descriptors retain each pre-restore handle, identify the same current post-restore handle, and report FEDERATE_RESTORING. The first Federate Restore Complete cannot finish the federation; the second yields Federation Restored, removes the post-save object, and leaves idle descriptors with null post-restore handles and NO_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS. C++ primary and contract were linked only against the installed 2026-10-20 package and passed with HLAinteger64Time and HLAfloat64Time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM object class/attribute, time implementation, and immediate callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_EVOKED for this direct-callback case, durable restore, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
